title.narrative: Activity under preparation Social Protection Systems Strengthening - AAP 2025

description.narrative: Contract related to: Social Protection Systems Strengthening - AAP 2025 - The Social Protection Systems Strengthening Action in Sub-Saharan Africa (SSA) is aimed at building inclusive, resilient, and sustainable social protection (SP) systems. This action supports the EU¿s Multi-Annual Indicative Programme for SSA under Priority Area 1: Human Development, focusing on reducing poverty, promoting gender equality, ensuring decent work, and advancing social inclusion. The action aligns with key African Union (AU) frameworks, including Agenda 2063, which underscores social protection as a critical component of economic stability and integration. It also supports the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), particularly SDG 1, No Poverty, Target 1.3.SSA¿s social protection systems face numerous structural challenges. With fewer than 20% of people in the region covered by any form of social protection, factors such as high levels of informality, limited fiscal resources, administrative capacity, inadequate benefit levels and fragmented policies contribute to substantial coverage gaps. These limitations, combined with pressures from recurring crises¿including the COVID-19 pandemic, climate change impacts, migration, economic instability and fragility contexts¿necessitate social protection systems that are adaptable, responsive, and accessible to vulnerable populations. Inadequate SP coverage leaves marginalized groups without necessary support systems, deepening poverty and widening social inequalities.A regional approach to SP across SSA offers substantial added value, fostering alignment of policy standards, enabling cross-border crisis-responsive measures, promoting portability of rights while facilitating exchange of experiences across countries. A regional approach can reduce disparities that lead to migration pressures and economic inequality while enhancing countries¿ abilities to respond cohesively to regional crises. The coordinated framework facilitates the exchange of best practices and collaborative learning among SSA countries. Collaboration at the regional level is also integral to achieving the ambitions of Agenda 2063, which emphasizes social protection as fundamental for economic integration, social cohesion, and sustainable development.This action has a clear results chain aimed at achieving the overall impact through specific objectives and outputs.The overall objective is to support and strengthen national social protection systems in SSA by leveraging a region-to-region approach. The ultimate aim is to enhance resilience, reduce poverty, and promote equitable economic growth aligned with the sustainable development agenda.The specific objectives are:Support Social Protection System Strengthening: This objective focuses on building SSA countries¿ capacity to design and implement robust, inclusive SP systems.
